## Requirements (contract extraction — RULING E-4 verbatim + ticket Notes)

1. **Byte budgets demote to warnings**, on every named surface:
   - the 48 KiB orient recipe (`orient-probe`/`probe-budget` V11;
     `guarded ledger-budget` at `check-build-memory.sh` ~L991, SIG-LOCAL L5);
   - the ledger-head budget (orient region ≤ 12 KiB, `orient-budget` V1;
     `guarded ledger-budget` ~L877);
   - the per-entry 2 KiB PHASE LOG budget (`phase-log`/`entry-budget` V4;
     `guarded ledger-budget` ~L970);
   - the notes-file budget — Phase-4 verified **no identifiable check**;
     the ADR names it unmatched (nearest: the generic >1 MB-fixture /
     >5 MB-file `size` warn ~L1175–1180, already warnings).
2. **Shape checks stay hard:** CURRENT STATE key order/vocabulary
   (`key-order`, `key-vocabulary`, `ledger-value`), keys outside the block
   (`key-shadow`), `| PRIOR` (`prior-history`), returnPass shape
   (`returnPass-grammar` — the grammar, not the cap), ≤ 256 B per
   CURRENT STATE line (`line-budget` — named hard by the ruling).
3. **New additive hard check:** CURRENT STATE block + ledger head
   combined ≤ 18 KiB (replaces the separate 12 KiB + 3 KiB fails).
4. **Split bundled ids before demoting:** the script's shared `$cap`
   line (~L896, SIG-LOCAL L8) guards both the ≤ 256 B CS lines (hard →
   still-guarded id `ledger-shape`) and the ≤ 1,024 B returnPass line
   (demotes → warn `ledger-budget`); the other `guarded ledger-budget`
   shape rules (`| PRIOR`, returnPass grammar, key-shadow, PHASE-LOG
   append target) move to `ledger-shape`. In `ledger_contract.py` the
   `line-budget` rule splits into `line-budget` (hard, ≤ 256 B) and
   `returnPass-line-budget` (warn, ≤ 1,024 B).
5. Demotions via **new tagged SIG-LOCAL hunks** — never untagged upstream
   edits; the provenance banner is updated and the diff vs pinned
   upstream (sha256 `f48a365d…`, release 0.5.0 @ `8aeb6dc`) verified to
   contain only tagged hunks. L5 retires into the same scheme (the probe
   returns to upstream `warn`).
6. `memory_guard.py` carries no byte budgets — consistency = verification
   (done; grep for the constants + budget/s KiB terms finds only
   sha256/prefix byte-identity append-only machinery).
7. "Never fold unless the fold archives every clause" — the existing
   fold/archive conventions under `docs/build/reports/memory-repair/`
   remain the only escape (ADR records it; no machinery change).
8. The ADR lands through `spec_src` `99a_appF_adr.md` + `BUILD.sh`
   byte-clean rebuild (`check_spec_src.py` exit 0), carries
   `## Revisit trigger` (SIG-STORE-007), `adr-index.sh` regen,
   `ADR_TRIGGERS.csv` BL-087 row, BACKLOG BL-087 title + sources cells,
   `BACKLOG.md` regenerated — and lists **each check id with its new
   severity**.
9. `test_ledger_contract.py` covers the warn-vs-fail split; all CI green.
